objective_text.T65.01.b: Implement total constructors and checked accessors while preserving output on rejected niche construction; do not copy uninitialized union members or compare padding.
objective_text.T65.01.c: Enumerate the reduced 8-bit model independently, then test actual UINT32_MAX and invalid discriminants. Measure sizeof and alignment on two available data models; a missing model is unavailable evidence. Kill premature-output-write and absence-uses-payload mutants.

Compare the exact documented Rust Option representation cases with this C design; no blanket ABI equivalence is allowed. Analyze void as an incomplete type with no values and _Noreturn as a function specifier. Compile a struct member of type void and an expression attempting to use a void result as a payload under strict C17 diagnostics; do not execute a falsely returning _Noreturn function. Construct a named one-state enum payload as a protocol-level unit and explain why it is not an uninhabited type or a general coercion rule.

sets.title: Single-evaluation propagation and atomic parser publication

objective_text.T65.02.a: Explain which failure stage owns the error offset, and why early-return propagation is not transaction rollback or automatic cleanup.
objective_text.T65.02.b: Implement strict checked accumulation and two single-evaluation propagation forms without statement expressions, strto* or parser libraries.
objective_text.T65.02.c: Generate all strings of length0–6 over digits0,1,9,colon,x and compare with an independent grammar/integer model. Add UINT32 bounds and long zero prefixes. Record callback/expression counters to kill double evaluation and retain a canary output for every rejection; kill premature publication and trailing-input acceptance mutants.
objective_text.T65.02.d: Replace the complete buffer with two incremental segments and preserve an explicit consumed position. Decide when an error position is absolute and when publication may occur; show a case where blindly returning the old error loses partial progress. The delayed variant adds a signed first field and forbids negative totals. Replace a proposed GNU statement-expression propagation macro with a C17 do-while statement macro taking an explicit output and goto label. Place it in an if/else and as an attempted initializer: explain why only the statement context is admitted. Count argument evaluation, test a name collision, and compare a static inline function when early return from the caller is unnecessary.
